sn32.13-52:1.2: nisinno kho so bhikkhu Bhagavantam etad avoca || ||
sn32.13-52:1.3: Ko nu kho bhante hetu ko paccayo yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā Uṇhavalāhakānaṃ devānaṃ || ||
sn32.13-52:1.7: Idha bhikkhu ekacco kāyena sucaritaṃ carati vācāya sucaritaṃ carati manasā sucaritaṃ carati ||
sn32.13-52:1.9: Vassavalāhakā deva dīghāyukā vaṇṇavanto sukhabahulā ti || || 5
sn32.13-52:1.11: Ahovatāhaṃ kāyassa bhedā param maraṇā vassavalāhakānaṃ devānam sahavyataṃ uppajjeyyanti ||
sn32.13-52:1.14: So kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā vāssavalāhakānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyatam upapajjatīti || || 6
sn32.13-52:1.15: Ayaṃ kho bhikkhave hetu ayam paccayo yenamidhekacco kāyassa bhedā paraṃmaraṇā vassavalāhakānaṃ devānaṃ sahavyatam upapajjatīti || || 1-3
